verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS research platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents an Elicit command-line tool. The evidence shows a programmatic API and an MCP server. The `claude mcp add` command belongs to Claude Code's own CLI, not to an Elicit CLI, so these are adjacent building blocks that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
